svg.title: Stretch Posture Coach - visual abstract
svg.desc: Sense with the Stretch 3 cameras and lidar, understand posture, falls and the room (lidar SLAM), act with spoken coaching, follow mode, fall alarms and control barrier functions, and share through a live web view, reports, VR telepresence with expert teleoperation and phone notifications. Bottom: examples from a real 14-minute session.
svg.text: Full-body biomechanics, spoken coaching and fall safety on a Hello Robot Stretch 3. Runs on the robot, no cloud.
